title: HARD KNUCKLES
subtitle: FRIDAY ARMS AND CORE. OFFICE SCALE. CLEAN LOCKOUTS. OWN THE WOBBLE.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. FRIDAY. HARD KNUCKLES. FIFTEEN MINUTES. ARMS AND CORE. THAT CHAIR IS NOT YOUR SANCTUARY, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. HARD KNUCKLES DONE. ARMS HONEST. CORE QUIET. SEE YOU TOMORROW.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UPS
exercises.cue: HANDS ON ABOUT THE FIFTH STAIR. CHEST TO THE EDGE. LOCK OUT CLEAN. KNEES LEGAL IF YOU MUST.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. FIFTH STAIR. CHEST IN. LOCK OUT. KNEES IF YOU MUST, YOU DESK JOCKEY. THIS IS YOUR ARMS WORK. NO HALF REPS.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE ARMS. DO NOT LIE DOWN.

exercises.name: STANDING SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: ARMS FORWARD, PINCH SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR POSTURE DRILL. SLOW AND CLEAN.
exercises.speakStart: STANDING SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF TEN. PINCH THE BLADES BACK AND DOWN. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR POSTURE DRILL. FIX THE DESK HUNCH. NO SHRUGS, YOU SLOPPY BUGGER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS QUIET.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: BACK FLAT ON THE FLOOR. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG REACH. RIBS DOWN. SLOW AND HONEST. NO ARCHING.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUG. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. BACK FLAT. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. RIBS DOWN. THIS IS YOUR CORE. DO NOT ARCH LIKE A LAZY HAMMOCK.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: LONG STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR FOR BALANCE. OWN THE WOBBLE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. FIVE EACH LEG. CONTROL THE DROP. CHAIR FOR BALANCE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT TIP OVER LIKE A DRUNK ON PARADE.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FLOOR OR A LOW STEP. HIPS LOW. STEADY DRIVE. ARMS AND CORE TOGETHER. DO NOT RUSH FORM.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS. HIPS LOW. STEADY. ARMS BRACED. CORE WORKING. EMPTY A BIT OF THE TANK. MOVE.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. BREATHE. NEXT ONE COMES FAST.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: HIPS HIGH. DROP THE BOTTOM KNEE. FIVE SECONDS ONLY. BUILD TOWARD TWENTY LATER. NO SAG.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANK. TWO HOLDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. HIPS UP. SHORT AND HONEST. WE ARE BUILDING TOWARD TWENTY. NO SAGGING.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
